otp.subject: Your Verification Code — Elder's Veil
otp.title: Verify Your Account
otp.preheader: Use your 6-digit OTP code to verify your Elder's Veil account.
otp.content:
Hello {{username}},

Thank you for creating an account with Elder's Veil. Please enter the verification code below to activate your profile:

{{otp}}

This verification code will expire in 10 minutes. If you did not register on Elder's Veil, please ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Elder's Veil! 📚
welcome.title: Welcome to the Realm
welcome.preheader: Your email is verified. Start reading exclusive comics and manga!
welcome.content:
Hello {{username}},

Your email address has been verified successfully! You now have full access to Elder's Veil's library of epic comics, manga, and manhwa.

Explore trending releases, bookmark your favorites, and track reading progress seamlessly across devices.

resetOtp.subject: Password Reset Code — Elder's Veil
resetOtp.title: Reset Your Password
resetOtp.preheader: Your 6-digit OTP code to reset your Elder's Veil account password.
resetOtp.content:
Hello {{username}},

We received a request to reset your password. Use the 6-digit verification code below to enter a new password:

{{otp}}

This code expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request a password reset, your account is safe and no action is required.

premiumRequested.subject: Premium Request Received — Elder's Veil
premiumRequested.title: Premium Request Under Review
premiumRequested.preheader: We have received your Premium membership request on Elder's Veil.
premiumRequested.content:
Hello {{username}},

Your request for Elder's Veil Premium Membership has been received and submitted for administrator review.

Status: Pending Administrator Approval

You will receive an email confirmation as soon as an administrator reviews and approves your request.

premiumActivated.subject: Premium Membership Activated — Elder's Veil 💎
premiumActivated.title: Welcome to Premium VIP!
premiumActivated.preheader: Your Premium access is active. Enjoy unlimited access to exclusive comics.
premiumActivated.content:
Hello {{username}},

Great news! Your Elder's Veil Premium Membership has been approved and activated until {{expiresAt}}.

You now enjoy exclusive perks including:

  • Unlimited access to all Premium comics and chapters
  • Ad-free immersive reading experience
  • Exclusive VIP badge on your profile and comments

premiumRejected.subject: Premium Request Update — Elder's Veil
premiumRejected.title: Premium Request Update
premiumRejected.preheader: Update regarding your Premium membership request on Elder's Veil.
premiumRejected.content:
Hello {{username}},

Thank you for your interest in Elder's Veil Premium. After review, your Premium membership request could not be approved at this time.

Note: {{reason}}

You may submit a new request from your User Dashboard at any time.

Hello {{username}},

Congratulations! Your comic submission "{{comicTitle}}" has been approved by our moderation team and is now published live on Elder's Veil.

comicRejected.title: Submission Feedback
comicRejected.content:

Your comic submission "{{comicTitle}}" was reviewed by our moderation team. Unfortunately, it cannot be published at this time.

Please update your submission in Creator Studio and resubmit for review.
